fact: The World Bank's program paper of 6 June 2025 states, in its monitoring plan, that SISMA (MISAU's DHIS2) data are routinely collected at service delivery points in health facilities on paper-based forms and then digitalized at district level into SISMA.
title: Program Paper on a Proposed Additional Grant to the Republic of Mozambique for the District and Community Health Services Revitalization Operation (Report No: PADPAF000013)
